reaction: The bubble gives the narrow stream another clear large-scale consequence.
reason: This is the only offered combination and directly addresses the remaining goal about cold gas.
expectation: I expect the expanding bubble to push or carry some cold cloud material outward; whether it remains bound to the galaxy is uncertain.

reason: Follow the clouds into the galaxies' outer reaches to address whether they are lost.
expectation: I expect to learn whether the outward-moving clouds remain bound or return, though their fate is uncertain.

effect: The clouds remain bound and fall back toward the centre, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The outward flow becoming a later inward flow is a satisfying reversal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cold clouds outward to their return was most worthwhile: it connected the jet's disturbance to a longer cycle of gas movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Following the jet through thin gas was the least engaging choice because it was the only offered combination, although the resulting bubble made its purpose clear.

surprise.text: The dense cloud interiors could remain cold while being carried outward by the hot disturbance.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the purpose of following the jet through thin gas was initially uncertain but became clear with the bubble.

continue.text: Yes; I would be curious to see what the returning cold gas does next, although the mostly forced sequence offered limited choices.
